Resize a box to small (2 vCPU, 8 GB), medium (4, 16) or large (4, 32): it stops for two to three minutes, and running turns stop with it; a stopped or hibernated box is resized and left stopped. --disk grows its disk (up to 300 GB, never smaller, once every six hours) with the box up.

Usage: termag box resize <box> [small|medium|large] [--disk <GB>] [--force] [--wait] [--timeout <seconds>] [--yes]

Global flags:
  --json          Machine-readable output
  --yes           Skip confirmations
  --host <url>    Orchestrator to use (or TERMAG_URL). Default: the production orchestrator,
                  or this box's own orchestrator when run on a box
  -h, --help      Show help
  --version       Show the version

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 usage error, 3 not found, 4 auth needed, 5 timeout.
